site_context.industry: YOUR_INDUSTRY (e.g., B2B SaaS, DTC E-Commerce, Fintech)
site_context.primary_audience: Describe your primary reader in one sentence — who they are and what they need
site_context.tone: Describe your brand voice in 1-2 sentences. Example: Authoritative but approachable. Data-driven. Practical over theoretical.
site_context.content_goals: What your content program is trying to achieve. Example: Thought leadership in [topic] + organic lead generation for [product]

authors.name: YOUR_AUTHOR_NAME
authors.title: YOUR_AUTHOR_TITLE
authors.bio: 2-3 sentence author bio. Include credentials, experience, and what makes this person qualified to write on your topics.

feature_image_style.style: Flat vector illustration, modern SaaS editorial style. 1920x1080 landscape. Thick deep purple outlines on all shapes. No gradients, no shadows, no text, no photorealism. Minimal elements. Clean, bold, uncluttered.
